source_context: Fork-only working validation for the explicit discriminant-tower witness. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the CyclotomicField 8 Q construction from the accepted roadmap, defined the two generators zeta+zeta^7 and zeta-zeta^7, proved their quadratic relations, used Eisenstein at 2 to identify their minimal polynomials, and packaged the resulting degree-two intermediate fields, top supremum, linear disjointness, and ambient degree/discriminant invariants. This is not intended as the final upstream submission: the remaining objective is to prove both quadratic subfield discriminants have absolute value 8 and then close the accepted loadBearing_of_witness theorem.
